title: console: publish-all-drafts and PendingDraftsBar toasts print `issues[].message` verbatim instead of the user's sentence
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: class a, a user-visible defect in the same class as #32984 Q1 (cards that speak in agent/API terms). Named by seat repo:objectstack#1 in its hand-off to this seat (mailbox comment 6933723686) as not filed. Dedupe: `usePublishAllDrafts toast`, `PendingDraftsBar issues message`; no open card.

reach: a named producer. The console's publish-all-drafts flow shows toasts built from `issues[].message`; re-check with `grep -rn "issues\[.*\]\.message\|issue.message" ui/packages/app-shell/src` near `usePublishAllDrafts` and `PendingDraftsBar`.

Suggested-grade: p2 · `domain:ui` · `pm:blocked`, Blocked-by #32984 (it consumes the `userMessage` field PR #34513 adds)

## 维护者速读

- 现象：控制台「全部发布草稿」(`usePublishAllDrafts`)和待发布草稿条(`PendingDraftsBar`)弹出的提示，把服务端返回的 `issues[].message` 原样打出来。用户看到的是面向开发者的英文报错。
- 为什么要修：和 #32984 Q1 是同一类问题(卡片说 agent/API 的话);Q1 修了构建聊天，这两处提示还没修。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Change

After PR #34513 merges, show each issue's `userMessage` and keep `message` out of user-facing text, the same way the #32984 console-read PR (#34539) does. Reuse its helper; do not write a second one. Pin it with a test that a publish failure shows the localized sentence.

## Done when

Neither toast can print `issues[].message`, and the pin test passes in two locales.

Blocked-by: #32984
